_comment: REJECTION FIXTURE: a DELETE declared non-destructive, cacheable, and running without approval. Any one of those is a governance hole; together they would let the engine cache the removal of a merchant's coupon.

interface.name: delete_coupon_unsafe
interface.title: Delete Coupon
interface.description: Deletes a discount coupon from the store permanently.
whenToUse: The merchant explicitly asks to delete a coupon.
whenNotToUse: The merchant wants to disable it temporarily -- update its status instead.
